alternate-gap.description: Gap between items in the alternating zigzag layout.

alternate-inner-gap.description: Gap between content and media within each zigzag item.

animation-blink.description: Blinking visibility loop. Use for cursor indicators or critical attention cues. Respect prefers-reduced-motion.

animation-color-pulse.description: Pulsing color loop. Use for live-status badges (recording, live). Respect prefers-reduced-motion.

animation-delay-1.description: Shortest stagger delay. Apply to the first element in a sequentially animated group.

animation-delay-5.description: Longest stagger delay. Apply to the last element in a sequentially animated group.

animation-fade-in.description: Fade-in entrance animation shorthand. Use directly as animation property value.

animation-float.description: Gentle floating / levitating loop. Use for hero illustrations or floating UI elements. Decorative — disable for prefers-reduced-motion.

animation-ping.description: Expanding ping / ripple loop. Use for notification badges and live-indicator dots.

animation-scale-down.description: Scale-down exit animation. Pairs with --sf-animation-scale-up for enter/leave transitions.

animation-scale-up.description: Scale-up entrance animation. Use for modals, popovers, and tooltips appearing.

animation-shimmer.description: Shimmer / skeleton-loading sweep. Apply on placeholder elements while content loads.

animation-slide-in-down.description: Slide-in from above. Use for dropdown menus and top-attached sheets.

animation-slide-in-left.description: Slide-in from the left. Use for left-side drawers and navigation panels.

animation-slide-in-right.description: Slide-in from the right. Use for right-side drawers and detail panels.

animation-slide-in-up.description: Slide-in from below. Use for bottom sheets, toasts, and floating action buttons.

animation-spin.description: Continuous rotation loop. Use for loading spinners and progress indicators.

aspect.description: Aspect ratio value for the .aspect-ratio macro.

bento-cols-default.description: Default column count for the bento grid.

bento-row-compact.description: Row height for compact-variant bento items.

bento-row-default.description: Default row height for standard bento grid cells.

bento-row-tall.description: Tall row height for visually prominent or hero bento cells.

blur.description: Backdrop-filter blur amount for frosted-glass surfaces (navbars, overlays, dialogs). Default 12px. Pair with a semi-transparent background.

body-color.description: Text color for body copy. Alias of --sf-color-text. Override here to deviate body text from the global text color.

body-em-style.description: font-style for <em> inside body text (italic by default). Override to suppress italics if your typeface has no italic variant.

body-font-family.description: Font family for body text. Alias of --sf-font-body.

body-font-size.description: Base font size for body paragraphs. Alias of --sf-text-m.

body-font-weight.description: Font weight for body text. Alias of --sf-font-weight-body.

body-line-height.description: Line height for body paragraphs. Alias of --sf-leading-normal.

body-strong-weight.description: Font weight for <strong> inside body text. Override to choose a specific weight instead of inheriting bold.

body-text-wrap.description: text-wrap mode for body paragraphs. 'pretty' prevents orphaned last words; 'balance' equalises line lengths.

border.description: Default border shorthand (width + solid + color). Apply directly to border property.

border-scale.description: Global border-width multiplier. Set to 0 for borderless UI; 0.5 for hairline-only; 2 to double all border widths across the system.

border-style.description: Global border-style default applied across all border tokens.

border-width-2.description: Medium 2px border width. Common for focus outlines.

border-width-4.description: Extra-thick 4px border width for decorative borders.

box-border-color.description: Border color for the box layout primitive.

box-border-width.description: Border width for the box layout primitive.

box-padding.description: Inner padding for the box layout primitive.

breakout-width.description: Width of full-bleed breakout elements inside a content grid.

button-radius.description: Border radius for buttons. Defaults to --sf-radius-m; override to fully pill-round or square all buttons at once.

caret-color.description: Cursor caret color inside text inputs and contenteditable elements.

center-gutter.description: Minimum side gutter for the center layout.

center-max.description: Maximum width for the center layout.

cluster-align.description: Vertical alignment of cluster items (align-items value).

cluster-gap.description: Gap between wrapped inline items in the cluster layout.

cluster-justify.description: Horizontal justification of the cluster (justify-content value).

code-font-size.description: Font size for inline <code> and <pre>. Usually slightly smaller than body text so monospace doesn't feel oversized.

color-action.description: Primary interactive color. Applied to filled buttons, active indicators, and brand accent surfaces.

color-action-100.description: Very light action shade. Hover fills on white surfaces, badge backgrounds.

color-action-200.description: Light action shade. Subtle fills and outlined badge backgrounds.

color-action-300.description: Light-mid action shade. Borders on light backgrounds, low-emphasis fills.

color-action-400.description: Mid-light action shade. Disabled state fills, decorative accents.

color-action-50.description: Lightest action tint. Background fill for subtle action-tinted surfaces.

color-action-500.description: Mid action shade — the 'pure' hue. Accessible on both light and dark backgrounds.

color-action-600.description: Mid-dark action shade. Text on light surfaces, icon fills.

color-action-700.description: Dark action shade. Strong text and icon fills on light backgrounds.

color-action-800.description: Very dark action shade. High-contrast text on white.

color-action-900.description: Near-black action shade. Extreme contrast on white surfaces.

color-action-950.description: Darkest action tint. Near-black for dark-theme surface accents.

color-action-a10.description: 10% opacity action tint. Subtle hover or selected-row background.

color-action-a5.description: 5% opacity action tint. Barely-there hover highlight.

color-action-a50.description: 50% opacity action tint. Mid-transparency badge or overlay.

color-action-dark.description: Registered <color> dark counterpart of --sf-color-action. Enables smooth CSS transitions when toggling between light and dark mode; without <color> registration the browser cannot interpolate and transitions snap at 50%.

color-action-darker.description: Deep action shade for high-contrast contexts.

color-action-ghost.description: Near-transparent action tint for ghost-button hover backgrounds.

color-action-light.description: OKLCH lightness source for the action color. Animate this to smoothly transition between light and dark brand themes.

color-action-lighter.description: Light action shade for soft accents.

color-action-muted.description: Medium action fill — outlined button hover backgrounds.

color-action-subtle.description: Lightest action tint — selected rows, active nav, chips.

color-action-superdark.description: Near-black action shade for maximum contrast on light surfaces.

color-action-superlight.description: Near-white action shade for maximum contrast on dark surfaces.

color-base.description: Secondary interactive color for supporting actions and secondary buttons.

color-base-100.description: Very light base shade. Hover fills, badge backgrounds.

color-base-300.description: Light-mid base shade. Borders on light backgrounds.

color-base-600.description: Mid-dark base shade. Text on light surfaces.

color-base-ghost.description: Near-transparent base tint for ghost-button hover backgrounds.

color-base-light.description: OKLCH lightness source for the base color.

color-bg.description: Base page / component background. The canvas all other surfaces layer on top of.

color-bg--active.description: Background tint for pressed/active interactive elements.

color-bg--focus.description: Background tint for focused interactive elements.

color-bg--hover.description: Background tint for hovered interactive elements (rows, list items, etc.).

color-bg--selected.description: Background for selected items (checked rows, active nav links).

color-border.description: Default border for dividers and component edges.

color-border--disabled.description: Semi-transparent border for disabled element edges.

color-border--strong.description: Stronger border for visually prominent edges and active outlines.

color-border--subtle.description: Low-contrast border for subtle separation without strong visual weight.

color-border--translucent.description: Translucent border for glass-morphism and frosted surfaces.

color-code-bg.description: Background for inline <code> elements. Usually a subtle tint of the inset surface.

color-code-text.description: Text color for inline code and monospace preformatted text.

color-danger.description: Destructive / danger state color. Used for delete actions, error alerts, and critical warnings.

color-danger-light.description: OKLCH lightness source for the danger status color.

color-danger-muted.description: Medium danger fill for icon backgrounds and badge fills.

color-danger-strong.description: High-contrast danger color for alert body text and icons.

color-danger-subtle.description: Light danger tint for error row backgrounds and alert container fills.

color-dim.description: Backdrop overlay color for modals, drawers, and lightboxes.

color-error.description: Form validation error color. Typically same hue as danger but can be tuned independently.

color-error-light.description: OKLCH lightness source for the error status color.

color-error-muted.description: Medium error fill for icons and inline badges.

color-error-strong.description: High-contrast error color for validation message text.

color-error-subtle.description: Light error tint for validation field backgrounds.

color-heading.description: Heading text color. Slightly stronger contrast than body text for visual hierarchy.

color-info.description: Informational color for neutral tips, hints, and non-urgent notices.

color-info-light.description: OKLCH lightness source for the info status color.

color-info-muted.description: Medium info fill for info icons and hint chips.

color-info-strong.description: High-contrast info color for hint body text.

color-info-subtle.description: Light info tint for informational note backgrounds.

color-inset.description: Slightly inset surface for nested areas — inputs, code blocks, sidebar panels.

color-inverse.description: Inverted (dark-on-light / light-on-dark) surface for high-contrast banners or tooltips.

color-link--disabled.description: Disabled link color (low contrast, no interaction).

color-link--underline.description: Color of the link underline decoration. Defaults to a semi-transparent variant of the link color.

color-neutral.description: Neutral interactive color for low-emphasis actions and tertiary buttons.

color-neutral-darker.description: Deep neutral shade for high-contrast contexts.

color-neutral-ghost.description: Near-transparent neutral tint for ghost-button hover backgrounds.

color-neutral-light.description: OKLCH lightness source for the neutral color.

color-neutral-muted.description: Muted neutral fill for low-emphasis contexts.

color-overlay.description: Overlay surface for floating panels, sheets, and modals.

color-primary.description: Raw primary palette token aliased from the action role by default. Override to decouple primary from action.

color-primary-ghost.description: Near-transparent primary tint for ghost-button hover backgrounds.

color-primary-light.description: OKLCH lightness source for the primary color.

color-raised.description: Elevated card surface that floats above the page background.

color-scheme.description: Preferred color scheme hint (light / dark / normal). Sent to the browser to influence UA chrome styling.

color-secondary.description: Raw secondary palette token for the secondary brand color.

color-secondary-ghost.description: Near-transparent secondary tint for ghost-button hover backgrounds.

color-secondary-light.description: OKLCH lightness source for the secondary color.

color-selection-bg.description: Background color applied to browser text selections.

color-selection-text.description: Text color inside browser text selections.

color-success.description: Positive / success color for confirmation messages and completed-state indicators.

color-success-light.description: OKLCH lightness source for the success status color.

color-success-muted.description: Medium success fill for success icons and status chips.

color-success-strong.description: High-contrast success color for confirmation message text.

color-success-subtle.description: Light success tint for confirmation backgrounds.

color-surface.description: Elevated surface color (e.g. card background one step above page background).

color-tertiary.description: Raw tertiary palette token for the third brand color.

color-tertiary-ghost.description: Near-transparent tertiary tint for ghost-button hover backgrounds.

color-tertiary-light.description: OKLCH lightness source for the tertiary color.

color-text.description: Primary text color. Contrasts against --sf-color-bg for body copy.

color-text--disabled.description: Text color for disabled UI elements. Intentionally low contrast.

color-text--inverse.description: Text color for use on dark/inverted backgrounds.

color-text--muted.description: Muted text for metadata, timestamps, and low-priority annotations.

color-text--on-action.description: Accessible foreground color for text on action-colored backgrounds.

color-text--on-base.description: Accessible foreground for text on base-colored backgrounds.

color-text--on-danger.description: Accessible foreground for text on danger-colored backgrounds.

color-text--on-error.description: Accessible foreground for text on error-colored backgrounds.

color-text--on-info.description: Accessible foreground for text on info-colored backgrounds.

color-text--on-inverse.description: Accessible foreground for text on inverted (dark-on-light / light-on-dark) backgrounds.

color-text--on-neutral.description: Accessible foreground for text placed on neutral-colored backgrounds.

color-text--on-primary.description: Accessible foreground for text placed on primary-colored backgrounds.

color-text--on-secondary.description: Accessible foreground for text placed on secondary-colored backgrounds.

color-text--on-success.description: Accessible foreground for text on success-colored backgrounds.

color-text--on-tertiary.description: Accessible foreground for text placed on tertiary-colored backgrounds.

color-text--on-warning.description: Accessible foreground for text on warning-colored backgrounds.

color-text--placeholder.description: Placeholder text color for inputs and textareas.

color-text--secondary.description: De-emphasised secondary text (captions, labels, supporting copy).

color-warning.description: Warning / caution color for non-critical alerts and degraded-state indicators.

color-warning-light.description: OKLCH lightness source for the warning status color.

color-warning-muted.description: Medium warning fill for icons and caution chips.

color-warning-strong.description: High-contrast warning color for caution text.

color-warning-subtle.description: Light warning tint for warning notification backgrounds.

component-pad.description: Standard inner padding for interactive components (buttons, form inputs, chips).

container-full.description: Full-width container — removes the max-width constraint.

container-narrow.description: Narrow content max-width — ideal for article body and blog posts (~65ch).

container-wide.description: Wide container for marketing / dashboard layouts (~1440px).

content-gap.description: Tight gap within related content (stack, flow, prose). Override globally to retune all tight primitives at once.

content-intrinsic-size.description: Intrinsic-size hint for content-visibility: auto (prevents layout shift on first reveal).

content-width.description: Max-width of the main content column in a content grid.

contrast-bias.description: Global text-contrast nudge. Positive values push derived reading-text colors toward the extremes (darker in light mode, lighter in dark). Default 0 (neutral).

contrast-threshold.description: OKLCH lightness crossover for auto-contrast on colored surfaces. Colors with L above this get dark text; below get light text. Default 0.6.

cover-min-height.description: Minimum height of the cover layout (typically 100svh).

cover-padding.description: Inner padding for the cover layout.

current-font-weight.description: Inherits the current font-weight from context. Useful as a reset.

display-l-line-height.description: Line height for large display text (--sf-text-display-l). Very tight to avoid excessive gaps at oversized sizes.

display-m-line-height.description: Line height for medium display text (--sf-text-display-m).

display-s-line-height.description: Line height for small display text (--sf-text-display-s).

divider-width.description: Stroke width of horizontal and vertical divider rules.

drop-shadow-l.description: Large CSS filter: drop-shadow for prominent illustrated or cut-out elements.

drop-shadow-m.description: Medium CSS filter: drop-shadow for elevated icons and card thumbnails.

drop-shadow-s.description: Small CSS filter: drop-shadow. Use filter (not box-shadow) for elements with transparent areas — SVGs, PNGs, cutout images.

duration-fast.description: Fast duration (~100ms). Hover transitions, tooltip appear.

duration-instant.description: Near-instant duration (~50ms). Micro-interactions and cursor-follow effects.

duration-normal.description: Normal duration (~200ms). Default for most transitions.

ease-in.description: Accelerating easing. Use for elements leaving the viewport.

ease-in-out.description: Symmetric easing. Use for elements that move within the viewport.

ease-linear.description: Linear easing. Use for progress indicators and spinner rotations.

ease-out.description: Decelerating easing. Use for elements entering the viewport.

ease-overshoot.description: Subtle overshoot easing. Softer spring effect.

equal-min-col.description: Minimum column width for the default auto-fill equal-columns layout. Columns fill the row until this width is reached, then wrap to the next line.

equal-min-col-2.description: Minimum column width for the 2-column equal preset.

equal-min-col-3.description: Minimum column width for the 3-column equal preset.

equal-min-col-4.description: Minimum column width for the 4-column equal preset.

equal-min-col-6.description: Minimum column width for the 6-column equal preset.

field-padding-block.description: Vertical (block) inner padding for form field inputs.

field-padding-inline.description: Horizontal (inline) inner padding for form field inputs.

field-radius.description: Border radius for form field inputs. Defaults to --sf-radius-m; override to reshape all inputs at once.

field-required-marker.description: CSS content value for required-field markers (e.g. " *"). Used by pseudo-elements in the .required utility pattern.

flow-space.description: Margin-block-start applied to all flow children except the first.

fluid-max-vw.description: Maximum viewport width (in rem) at which the fluid scale clamps to its largest values. Default 90rem (~1440px). Part of the fluid scale engine.

fluid-min-vw.description: Minimum viewport width (in rem) at which the fluid scale clamps to its smallest values. Default 22.5rem (~360px). Part of the fluid scale engine.

focus-ring-color.description: Color of the keyboard focus ring. Ensure sufficient contrast against all background surfaces.

focus-ring-offset.description: Gap between the element edge and the focus ring.

focus-ring-shadow.description: Computed box-shadow value for the focus ring — two-layer technique: offset shadow in bg color, then ring shadow in focus-ring color. Tune via --sf-focus-ring-width and --sf-focus-ring-color instead of overriding this directly.

focus-ring-style.description: Border style of the focus ring (solid, dashed, dotted).

focus-ring-width.description: Stroke width of the focus ring outline.

font-body.description: Font family stack for body text. Override to set your primary typeface.

font-display.description: Font family for display/marketing text. Override for large headline typefaces.

font-features.description: OpenType feature-settings string for body text (e.g. 'ss01', 'cv11'). Default 'normal'. Override on :root or a subtree to enable ligatures, alternate glyphs, etc.

font-geometric.description: Geometric sans-serif slot — circular letterforms for brand alternates.

font-heading.description: Font family for headings. Defaults to display if not overridden separately.

font-humanist.description: Humanist sans-serif slot — warm, readable alternate typeface.

font-mono.description: Monospace font family for code, pre, and kbd elements.

font-numeric.description: font-variant-numeric shorthand (e.g. tabular-nums) for aligned numeric data.

font-slab.description: Slab-serif slot for editorial or display headings.

font-variation.description: Variable-font axis settings for body text (e.g. "wght" 450). Default 'normal'. Override on :root or a subtree to activate variable-font axes.

font-weight-body.description: Font weight for body text (typically 400 / normal).

font-weight-interactive.description: Font weight for interactive role text — buttons, badges, and navigation labels. Defaults to semibold.

font-weight-light.description: Light weight (300). Use sparingly — check contrast at small sizes.

font-weight-medium.description: Medium weight (500). Subtle emphasis without full bold.

font-weight-semibold.description: Semibold weight (600). Common for labels and subheadings.

font-weight-strong.description: Font weight for strong/emphasis inline role. Defaults to bold.

frame-ratio.description: Aspect ratio for the frame (media container) layout.

gap.description: Default gap between components (the loose rhythm). Layout primitives like cluster/grid/sidebar default to it. Override globally to retune them all at once, or set a primitive token (e.g. --sf-cluster-gap) for one element.

gradient-brand.description: Multi-stop brand gradient spanning primary and secondary palette colors. Use for hero backgrounds and brand accents.

gradient-fade--b.description: Fade-to-bottom gradient (transparent → surface). Use to fade content into a background below (infinite scroll fade, content cutoff).

gradient-fade--l.description: Fade-to-left gradient. Use to indicate left-side scrollable overflow.

gradient-fade--r.description: Fade-to-right gradient. Use to indicate right-side scrollable overflow.

gradient-fade--t.description: Fade-to-top gradient (transparent → surface). Use to fade content into a background above.

gradient-primary.description: Gradient using primary palette colors (light to saturated).

gradient-surface.description: Subtle surface-color gradient for depth layering and glass effects.

grid-min.description: Minimum column width for the auto-fill grid.

grid-min-2xl.description: Minimum column width at the 2× breakpoint.

grid-min-l.description: Large minimum column width for the auto-fill grid.

grid-min-m.description: Medium minimum column width for the auto-fill grid.

grid-min-s.description: Small minimum column width for the auto-fill grid.

grid-min-xl.description: Extra-large minimum column width for the auto-fill grid. Use for wide content cards.

grid-min-xs.description: Extra-small minimum column width for the auto-fill grid. Use for very compact tile layouts (icon grids).

gutter.description: Wide page/section-edge gutter (used by center/container). Override to set the page-edge breathing room across breakpoints.

h1-letter-spacing.description: Letter-spacing for <h1>. Typically slightly negative at large sizes.

h1-line-height.description: Line height for <h1>. Tighter than body to avoid excessive whitespace at large sizes.

h1-max-width.description: Max-inline-size cap for <h1>. Default none (unconstrained). Set to a ch value (e.g. 20ch) to prevent wide headings from spanning the full column on large screens.

header-height.description: Total height of the sticky page header. Used by --sf-sticky-offset to prevent content from hiding under it.

heading-color.description: Text color for all headings (h1–h6). Alias of --sf-color-heading.

heading-font-family.description: Font family for all headings. Alias of --sf-font-heading.

heading-text-wrap.description: text-wrap for headings. 'balance' prevents orphaned short last lines in multi-line headings.

icon-2xl.description: 2× large icon size (~40px+). Hero or onboarding icons.

icon-box-bg.description: Background color for boxed icon containers.

icon-box-radius.description: Border radius for boxed icon containers.

icon-l.description: Large icon size (~24px). Standalone icon buttons.

icon-m.description: Medium icon size (~20px). Default for inline and button icons.

icon-s.description: Small icon size (~16px). Dense UI chrome.

imposter-margin.description: Margin between the imposter overlay and the viewport edges.

is-active.description: Integer state flag for the active state. Set to 1 (via JS or .is-active) to drive branching calc() expressions. 0 = default (inactive).

is-current.description: Integer state flag for the current/selected state. Set to 1 (via .is-current) to drive branching calc() expressions. 0 = default.

is-dark.description: Mode flag — 0 in light mode, 1 in dark mode. Set automatically by [data-theme='dark'] and prefers-color-scheme. Drives dark-mode formula branches in calc().

is-open.description: Integer state flag for the open/expanded state. Set to 1 (via .is-open) to drive branching calc() expressions. 0 = default (closed).

is-pressed.description: Integer state flag for the pressed state. Set to 1 (via .is-pressed) to drive branching calc() expressions. 0 = default.

leading-normal.description: Normal line height (~1.5). Default for body text.

leading-relaxed.description: Relaxed line height (~1.65). Long-form reading text.

leading-snug.description: Snug line height (~1.35). Use for sub-headings.

leading-taper.description: Progressive leading tightener: each step up the type scale subtracts step-index × taper from its per-size line-height token (tokens.sizes-extended). Default 0 keeps the curated defaults.

leading-tight.description: Tight line height (~1.2). Use for large display headings.

line-clamp.description: Number of visible lines before text is clipped with an ellipsis.

link-external-marker.description: CSS content value appended to external links (e.g. " ↗"). Used by the .external-link pseudo-element pattern.

link-underline-offset.description: Vertical offset of the link underline from the text baseline.

link-underline-thickness.description: Stroke width of the link underline.

lumlocker.description: OKLCH lightness lock value. When :root has [data-lumlocker], brand colors (primary, secondary, action, base) are remapped to this L so their contrast remains constant as hues shift.

mask-scrim-end.description: End stop for edge-fade mask gradients. Mirrors --sf-mask-scrim-start for the trailing edge of a scroll container.

mask-scrim-start.description: Start stop for edge-fade mask gradients on scroll reels / overflow containers. Use in mask-image: linear-gradient(..., transparent var(--sf-mask-scrim-start)) to fade content near the leading edge.

motion-scale.description: Global motion multiplier. All transition and animation durations multiply by this factor. Set to 0 to disable all motion; reduce below 1 for snappier feel.

object-fit.description: Default object-fit value for replaced elements (img, video).

opacity-muted.description: General de-emphasis opacity for secondary content, ghost elements, or non-primary layers. Default 0.5.

optical-sizing.description: CSS font-optical-sizing value. 'auto' lets the browser optimize letterforms for the rendered size. Set 'none' to disable optical sizing.

palette-mix-100.description: Color-mix percentage for palette step 100. Controls blend depth toward the surface. Default 8%.

palette-mix-200.description: Color-mix percentage for palette step 200. Controls blend depth toward the surface. Default 20%.

palette-mix-300.description: Color-mix percentage for palette step 300. Controls blend depth toward the surface. Default 40%.

palette-mix-400.description: Color-mix percentage for palette step 400 (near-mid tint). Controls blend depth. Default 65%.

palette-mix-50.description: Color-mix percentage for the lightest palette step (50). Controls how far step 50 blends toward the surface. Default 4%.

palette-mix-600.description: Color-mix percentage for palette step 600 (near-mid shade). Controls blend depth toward the text color. Default 82%.

palette-mix-700.description: Color-mix percentage for palette step 700. Controls blend depth toward the text color. Default 62%.

palette-mix-800.description: Color-mix percentage for palette step 800 (dark shade). Controls blend depth toward text. Default 38%.

palette-mix-900.description: Color-mix percentage for palette step 900 (very dark shade). Controls blend depth toward text. Default 18%.

palette-mix-950.description: Color-mix percentage for the darkest palette step (950). Controls how far step 950 blends toward the text color. Default 8%.

print-base-size.description: Base font size for @media print stylesheets. Default 11pt. Override on :root to adjust printed body text size.

print-page-margin.description: Page margin for printed output. Default 2cm. Maps to @page margin.

print-page-size.description: Target paper size for printing. Default 'a4'. Maps to @page size. Common values: a4, letter, legal.

prose-block-margin.description: Block margin between prose elements (h2, p, ul, etc.).

prose-blockquote-border.description: Left border style for blockquotes inside prose.

prose-blockquote-padding.description: Inner padding for blockquotes inside prose.

prose-figcaption-size.description: Font size for figure captions inside .prose. Typically smaller than body text.

prose-heading-gap.description: Space between a heading and the content that follows it inside .prose.

prose-marker-color.description: Color of list bullets and ordered-list numbers inside .prose.

prose-media-margin.description: Block margin around images, video, and figures inside .prose.

prose-media-radius.description: Border radius applied to images and media inside .prose.

prose-nested-list-gap.description: Gap between items in nested lists inside .prose.

prose-paragraph.description: Max width of prose paragraphs (layout token for the prose layout).

radius-2xs.description: Extra-extra-small radius (~1px). Minimal rounding for very tight UI elements.

radius-full.description: Full rounding (50%). For circular elements like avatars.

radius-m.description: Medium radius (~6–8px). Default — inputs, standard buttons, cards.

radius-outer.description: Concentric corner helper: outer radius for a container that wraps content with inner radius of --sf-radius-m. Computed as --sf-radius-m + --sf-component-pad so corners align visually.

radius-pill.description: Pill rounding (9999px). Tags, toggle pills, status badges.

radius-s.description: Small radius (~4px). Badges, chips, small buttons.

radius-scale.description: Global border-radius multiplier. Scales the entire radius ramp up (>1) or down (<1) from one knob. Set to 0 for sharp corners everywhere.

radius-xl.description: Extra-large radius (~16px). Prominent cards and feature blocks.

radius-xs.description: Hairline radius (~2px). Subtle rounding for tight components.

ratio-3-2.description: 3:2 aspect ratio. Common for landscape photography.

ratio-square.description: 1:1 square aspect ratio. Use for avatars, icon containers, and square thumbnails.

ratio-video.description: 16:9 widescreen video aspect ratio. Use for video embeds and video-thumbnail containers.

reel-gap.description: Gap between items in the horizontal reel.

reel-height.description: Fixed height of the reel container.

reel-item-width.description: Width of each item in the reel.

safe-bottom.description: Device safe-area inset at the bottom edge (home indicator, gesture bar). Resolves to env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px). Use for fixed footers.

safe-left.description: Device safe-area inset at the left edge. Resolves to env(safe-area-inset-left, 0px).

safe-right.description: Device safe-area inset at the right edge (rounded corners, home indicator). Resolves to env(safe-area-inset-right, 0px).

safe-top.description: Device safe-area inset at the top edge (notch, Dynamic Island). Resolves to env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px). Use for fixed headers on notched devices.

scrim-color.description: Base color of the gradient scrim overlay.

scrim-direction.description: Direction of the scrim gradient (to bottom, to top, etc.).

scrim-gradient.description: Full gradient shorthand for the scrim. Override to customise the fade.

scrim-text-shadow.description: Text-shadow layered over the scrim gradient to ensure legibility for text placed directly on image backgrounds.

scroll-shadow-size.description: Size of the scroll-shadow fade effect on overflowing containers.

scroll-timeline-range-end.description: animation-range end value for scroll-driven entrance effects. Default 'cover 30%'. Override on an element to control when its entrance animation finishes.

scroll-timeline-range-start.description: animation-range start value for scroll-driven entrance effects. Default 'entry 0%'. Override on an element to control when its entrance animation begins.

scrollbar-thumb.description: Color of the custom scrollbar thumb.

scrollbar-track.description: Color of the custom scrollbar track.

section-pad.description: Default vertical padding for full-width page sections.

section-pad--2xl.description: 2× large section vertical padding for hero areas.

section-pad--xl.description: Extra-large vertical section padding for hero and feature sections.

section-pad--xs.description: Extra-small vertical section padding for compact in-page modules.

section-scale.description: Global multiplier applied to every --sf-section-pad--* size — one dial re-rhythms all section padding (default 1).

shadow-2xl.description: Largest shadow for hero cards, feature highlights, and marketing surfaces.

shadow-color.description: Near-black shadow tint derived from the neutral palette. Inherits the neutral's chroma and hue so colorless neutrals produce colorless shadows.

shadow-glow.description: Glow box-shadow shorthand for decorative glow effects.

shadow-glow-color.description: Ambient glow tint used by --sf-shadow-glow. Override to retint all glow shadows; opacity and dark-mode boost are controlled by --sf-shadow-strength.

shadow-inner.description: Inset shadow for pressed states, inset inputs, and recessed surfaces.

shadow-l.description: Large shadow for drawers, sidebars, and prominent elevated surfaces.

shadow-lightness.description: OKLCH lightness component of the shadow color. Lower = denser-looking shadows. Tune this independently of --sf-shadow-strength to control tonal weight without affecting opacity.

shadow-m.description: Medium shadow for cards and content panels.

shadow-none.description: No box-shadow (resets inherited shadows). Use to explicitly remove elevation.

shadow-s.description: Small shadow for chips, tags, and inline elevated surfaces.

shadow-strength.description: Base opacity for the entire shadow ramp. Auto-boosted in dark mode via --sf-is-dark. Override with calc() to preserve the adaptation: e.g. calc(0.12 + var(--sf-is-dark) * 0.17).

shadow-xl.description: Extra-large shadow for modals, dialogs, and high-elevation sheets.

shadow-xs.description: Extra-small shadow for barely-elevated elements (focused inputs, small chips).

sidebar-gap.description: Gap between sidebar and main content column.

sidebar-min-width.description: Minimum sidebar width before the layout collapses to stacking.

sidebar-width.description: Preferred width of the sidebar column.

size-l.description: Large UI component height (~44px). Touch-friendly interactive elements.

size-m.description: Medium UI component height (~36px). Default size for buttons and inputs.

size-s.description: Small UI component height (~28px). Compact buttons and input variants.

size-xl.description: Extra-large interactive component height (~52px). For oversized or prominently touch-friendly controls.

size-xs.description: Extra-small interactive component height (~24px). For very compact inline elements and micro-controls.

space-2xs.description: 4px-equivalent spacing. Tight inline gaps, icon-to-text padding.

space-base-max.description: Maximum base spacing unit (rem) at the widest viewport. Drives the top of the fluid spacing ramp. Part of the fluid scale engine.

space-base-min.description: Minimum base spacing unit (rem) at the narrowest viewport. Drives the bottom of the fluid spacing ramp. Part of the fluid scale engine.

space-none.description: Zero spacing. Explicit alias for clarity in utility classes.

space-px.description: 1px spacing. Hairline offset for fine adjustments.

space-ratio-max.description: Modular spacing ratio at the widest viewport. Controls step-to-step growth in the spacing ramp. Default 1.333 (perfect fourth). Part of the fluid scale engine.

space-ratio-min.description: Modular spacing ratio at the narrowest viewport. Controls step-to-step growth in the spacing ramp. Default 1.25 (major third). Part of the fluid scale engine.

space-s.description: 12px-equivalent spacing. Form field inner padding, narrow gaps.

space-scale.description: Global spacing multiplier. Scales the fluid spacing ramp. Increase above 1 for airier layouts; reduce below 1 for compact UIs.

space-xl.description: 32px-equivalent spacing. Feature row gaps, generous section padding.

space-xs.description: 8px-equivalent spacing. Compact list rows, tab padding.

stack-gap.description: Vertical gap between stacked block-level elements in the stack layout.

state-pending-opacity.description: Opacity for pending / loading state elements.

sticky-offset.description: top offset for position: sticky elements, accounting for the header height.

surface-color.description: Input for the generic .sf-surface macro. Set any color (including palette shades); the macro derives background, auto-contrast foreground, and the contextual token set from it.

switcher-threshold.description: Inline-size threshold below which the switcher flips from horizontal to vertical.

text-2xs.description: Extra-extra-small font size (~11px). Fine print, badges.

text-2xs-font-weight.description: Font weight for 2×-extra-small text. Override to deviate from the global weight at this size.

text-2xs-max-width.description: Optimal line length (max-width in ch) for 2×-extra-small text.

text-3xl-letter-spacing.description: Letter-spacing for 3×-large text. Typically negative to tighten large headings.

text-base-max.description: Maximum base font size (rem) at the widest viewport. End point for the fluid type scale at wide screens. Part of the fluid scale engine.

text-base-min.description: Minimum base font size (rem) at the narrowest viewport. Starting point for the fluid type scale at narrow screens. Part of the fluid scale engine.

text-display-base-max.description: Maximum display/hero font size (rem) at the widest viewport. Drives the ceiling of the fluid display type scale. Part of the fluid scale engine.

text-display-base-min.description: Minimum display/hero font size (rem) at the narrowest viewport. Drives the floor of the fluid display type scale. Part of the fluid scale engine.

text-display-l.description: Large display font size (~68px+). Oversized hero text.

text-display-m.description: Medium display font size (~54px). Hero headings.

text-display-s.description: Small display font size (~42px). Hero sub-headings.

text-display-scale.description: Multiplier applied only to the display/hero type scale (--sf-text-display-*). Tune headline impact independently of body text.

text-l.description: Large font size (~18px). Lead paragraphs, prominent labels.

text-l-max-width.description: Optimal line length for large text.

text-m.description: Medium / base font size (~16px). Typical body text.

text-m-max-width.description: Optimal reading line length for medium text (~65–75ch).

text-ratio-max.description: Modular type scale ratio at the widest viewport. Controls step-to-step size growth. Default 1.333. Part of the fluid scale engine.

text-ratio-min.description: Modular type scale ratio at the narrowest viewport. Controls step-to-step size growth in the fluid type ramp. Default 1.25. Part of the fluid scale engine.

text-s.description: Small font size (~14px). Secondary content, UI annotations.

text-s-max-width.description: Optimal line length for small text.

text-scale.description: Global type-size multiplier. Scales the entire fluid type scale. 1.08 gives noticeably larger body text without breaking layout.

text-shadow-l.description: Large text-shadow for high-contrast text over busy or dark image backgrounds.

text-shadow-m.description: Medium text-shadow. Use for text overlaid on images to improve legibility.

text-shadow-none.description: Removes text-shadow (use to explicitly reset inherited shadows).

text-shadow-s.description: Small text-shadow for subtle depth on display headings.

text-xl.description: Extra-large font size (~20px). Sub-headings, callout text.

text-xl-max-width.description: Optimal line length for extra-large text.

text-xs.description: Extra-small font size (~12px). Labels, captions, metadata.

text-xs-max-width.description: Optimal line length for extra-small text.

theme-transition-duration.description: Duration of the .sf-theme-transition animated color-scheme crossfade. Scales with --sf-motion-scale so reduced-motion preferences are respected. Default 300ms.

touch-target.description: Minimum touch-target size for interactive elements per WCAG 2.5.5.

tracking-normal.description: Normal letter-spacing (0). Default for body text.

tracking-tight.description: Tight letter-spacing (slightly negative). Suitable for large headings.

tracking-wide.description: Wide letter-spacing. Use for small-caps labels.

tracking-wider.description: Wider letter-spacing for strongly spaced labels.

transition-colors.description: Transition shorthand for color-related properties (color, background, border-color).

transition-enter.description: Enter-phase transition (ease-out). Use on elements appearing in the viewport.

transition-exit.description: Exit-phase transition (ease-in). Use on elements leaving the viewport.

transition-form-field.description: Transition shorthand optimised for form fields: color and background at normal pace so label color shifts feel natural; border, shadow, and opacity at fast pace so focus rings appear crisply.

transition-overlay.description: Transition shorthand for overlay fades (opacity + visibility).

z-base.description: Base stacking level (1). Establishes a stacking context without elevation.

z-below.description: Z-index below stacking context base. For decorative pseudo-elements.

z-dropdown.description: Z-index for dropdown menus and select popups.

z-modal.description: Z-index for modal dialogs and their non-top-layer backdrop scrims. Sits above overlays and dropdowns. Default 1040.

z-sticky.description: Z-index for position: sticky elements (navbars, table headers).

z-tooltip.description: Z-index for tooltips and transient floating notifications. Highest named layer in the z-index stack. Default 1060.
